headline: A pregame 1st/2nd/3rd-string replacement signal is NOT obtainable from official sources at any price. A postgame replacement FACTS table is obtainable and is published below.

capability_matrix.http_result: 404 - official 'Flag on the Play' error page

capability_matrix.yields: player, jersey number, position, a transaction status code (ACT / CUT / DEV / PUP), height, weight, experience, college
capability_matrix.cannot: any ordering within a position. Two ACT quarterbacks are listed alphabetically, not by depth

capability_matrix.yields: player, position, injury, practice participation, game status (Out / Doubtful / Questionable / blank)
capability_matrix.cannot: whether the listed player is a starter, or who replaces him

capability_matrix.http_result: 200 - but the score renders as 'Hidden Score' after the game is final
capability_matrix.yields: links to the game book PDF and to per-game injury notes
capability_matrix.cannot: the final score in the rendered text, so it is not used as a result source

capability_matrix.yields: the 11 named starters on each side of the ball, the full substitution list, 'Did Not Play' and 'Not Active' lists, per-player stats
capability_matrix.cannot: pregame availability: the file does not exist until the game has been played, so it cannot inform a pregame line

capability_matrix.what: coach/beat reporting inside the official news hub
capability_matrix.yields: named starting-quarterback changes published by the club, e.g. 'Deshaun Watson will start Sunday'
capability_matrix.cannot: the same coverage for every position. It is a narrative source: uneven, club-dependent, and it does not exist for most offensive-line or secondary changes

what_the_operator_asked_for: Track injuries and know when a 2nd, 3rd or 4th string player must replace a starter, on offence and defence.
what_is_deliverable_today: which players are officially OUT / DOUBTFUL / QUESTIONABLE before kickoff, by team and position group (this page, 345 official rows)
which named quarterback changes hands, where the club said so publicly (6 cases this week, each with its official URL)
after the game: exactly who started on each side of the ball, from the official Game Book PDF
what_is_not_deliverable: the depth position of a player before the game, for any position, from any official NFL source
the identity of the replacement before the club announces it
snap counts or participation percentages before the game
workaround_that_stays_honest: Build the replacement signal from the injury report plus the postgame game book: when a listed starter is ruled Out and the game book shows a different player starting at that position, that is an official, verifiable replacement event. It can be collected from Week 10 onward, and after 6-8 weeks it will give a measured distribution of 'how much worse does the offence/defence perform with the backup', which is the quantity the operator actually wants. Until then any pregame depth weight would be invented.
